subject: Computer Networking
title: Core Web Vitals
description: A short lesson to help you apply Core Web Vitals.

hook.text: Google measures your site's speed with three metrics. They affect your ranking. Meet the Core Web Vitals.

buildup.text: LCP — Largest Contentful Paint. How fast the main content appears. Target: under 2.5 seconds.

discovery.text: INP — Interaction to Next Paint. How fast the page responds to clicks. Target: under 200 milliseconds.

twist.text: CLS — Cumulative Layout Shift. How much the page jumps around while loading. Target: under 0.1.

climax.text: Chrome collects real user data (CrUX). Google uses it for ranking. Lab scores help debug, field data decides rank.

punchline.text: Core Web Vitals: how fast, how responsive, how stable. Three scores that matter.

quiz.question: What does LCP measure?
options: How fast the largest visible content element loads
How many layout shifts occur during page load
How quickly the page responds to user input

details.summary: Core Web Vitals are Google's three metrics measuring real-world user experience: Largest Contentful Paint for loading speed, Interaction to Next Paint for responsiveness, and Cumulative Layout Shift for visual stability. They are ranking factors for Google search and guide performance optimization.
details.whyItMatters: Core Web Vitals quantify user experience into measurable scores that affect search rankings. Optimizing them improves both the user experience and a site's visibility in Google search results.
takeaways: LCP measures how fast the main content becomes visible
INP measures how quickly the page responds to interactions
CLS measures unexpected layout shifts during page load

faq.question: What are good Core Web Vitals scores?
faq.answer: Good LCP is under 2.5 seconds. Good INP is under 200 milliseconds. Good CLS is under 0.1. These are measured at the 75th percentile of real user experiences. Google's PageSpeed Insights and Chrome User Experience Report provide real-world data for any public URL.

faq.question: How do Core Web Vitals affect SEO?
faq.answer: Core Web Vitals are a confirmed Google ranking factor since 2021. They serve as a tiebreaker when content relevance is similar between pages. Sites with poor vitals may rank lower than equivalent sites with good vitals.
